# Audit: the POKéDEX redraws only when its selection changes or a species is
# added (TForm8.UpdateDisplay). An evolution that registers the species shown
# leaves its attacks as "???" until the species is selected again.
party 1 16
> start
> menu Actions > View POKéDEX
> combo Form8.ComboBox1 1
> menu Actions > Evolve a POKéMON
dialog information "Doubleclick a POKéMON in the Statistics window to evolve it. Once you have doubleclicked on a POKéMON, Evolution Mode will be disabled." -> OK
> answer yes
> choose 1
dialog information "# 001 Bulbasaur, L.16, XP:4096, XP to next level:817" -> OK
dialog confirmation "Your Bulbasaur can evolve into Ivysaur. Do you want to evolve it?" -> Yes
dialog information "Bulbasaur evolved into Ivysaur!" -> OK
> combo Form8.ComboBox1 0
> combo Form8.ComboBox1 1
> quit
exit 0
save line 21: "FALSE" -> "TRUE"
save line 406: "1" -> "2"
